_note: Fictional narration for the demo (an observer describing an episode, switching between English and Arabic). Edit freely, then run: .\bayn sample-audio

demo.text: Okay, it is ten fifteen in the morning. He was reading, and then he suddenly stopped.
الآن لا يرد عندما أناديه، وعيناه تنظران إلى الأمام.
His right hand is making small repeated movements. I am timing it now.
مرت تقريبا ثلاثون ثانية. لا يوجد سقوط، وهو جالس على الكرسي.
The movements are slowing down. He is blinking and looking around.
يقول إنه متعب قليلا ولا يتذكر ما حدث.
It lasted about one minute in total. He is breathing normally and talking again.

en_short.text: Please write down the time. The episode started a moment ago.

ar_short.text: بدأت النوبة قبل دقيقة، وهو الآن يتنفس بشكل طبيعي.
